conditions: run_stress_suite.sh: docker compose stack + docker-compose.stress.yml, mock upstream, in-process scanning, shipped default policy with the operator_state authorization allowlist added
load_note: Load P95 is hardware-specific. The 2026-10-01 run on a 16-core machine measured p95 4.7 / 4.1 / 4.8 ms at 100 / 500 / 1000 RPS with 0 errors.
